name: Death Music
description: Change NONG randomly after death on the level you trying to complete!

mod-active.name: Change music on death
mod-active.description: Turns the NONG switching on or off

min-percent.name: Change from level percent
min-percent.description: The NONG only changes if you die at this percent of the level or later. Not used when random chance is on

change-on-startpos.name: Change music in start pos
change-on-startpos.description: Also change the NONG when you play from a start pos

pause-button-left.name: Pause button on the left
pause-button-left.description: On puts the pause menu buttons in the bottom left corner, off puts them in the bottom right. Applies the next time you pause

use-chance.name: Use random chance
use-chance.description: Ignores the level percent. Every death gets a chance to change the NONG instead

change-chance.name: Change chance (%)
change-chance.description: Chance that a death changes the NONG. Only used when random chance is on
